q1_landing_at_built.question: Is there anything at 5632495 that makes landing the member at BUILT wrong?
q1_landing_at_built.reasoning:
Nothing here is a regression, a weakened oracle, a check that passes when it should not, or a standing the member does not hold. The merge is a clean disjoint union of two file sets that do not touch; verify.py exits 0 twice at 57 checks and lint.py exits 0 twice; the generated page regenerates byte-identically; no secrets, absolute paths or CRLF entered. The member lands at standing BUILT, work_state PRESENTED, stage_observed_by null, and sov_active_phase_progress reads P15-X4 as NOT_EARNED, so no clause advances by landing. I checked the one thing that would make landing self-serving - whether the member could become its own cited basis - and it cannot: gather() admits only WITNESSED or ACCEPTED at LANDED, and I confirmed by setting work_state to LANDED in a copy that the basis stays at three sources and the proposal id does not move. Seven claimed repairs, and I reproduced all seven with my own plants.

Three defects belong in the answer even though none of them blocks. q2_standing_refusal.question: Does anything at 5632495 change the view that BUILT -> WITNESSED is not supported?
q2_standing_refusal.answer: NO. I would refuse it too.
q2_standing_refusal.reasoning:
The artifact is better at 5632495 than at any prior revision on this branch and that is not what the refusal turns on. Three reasons, in the order I weight them.

First, my own position. I share a container and a model family with the builder, I read a task prompt the builder wrote which named six specific things to attack, and the scratchpad I was handed already held passes 5 and 6's working files. Every one of those makes this a second reading rather than an independent one. AGENTS.md says a build cannot witness itself and that no reading is authority; a reading directed by the builder from inside the builder's container is not the thing BUILT -> WITNESSED names, whatever it finds. I found three defects, which is evidence the reading was real, and not evidence it was independent.

Second, the one reading with a claim to real separation is compromised in the other direction. Pass 4 declares built_the_repair: true and says in its own record that its account of f43ee9a is a build claim rather than a witness. It read e898d06 independently, found the title defect, and built the fix. So the series has six readings and no reading that both came from outside the build chain and stayed outside it. The governed note does not record this (W7-F3).

Third, coverage. Two consequential behaviours the artifact asserts still carry no case proving the required refusal (W7-F4, W7-F5), and W7-F5 is one instance-data edit away from moving the live verdict with the whole gate green. AGENTS.md makes that a bar on its own. It is a much smaller bar than pass 6 recorded - six became two - and it is still a bar.

What would change my answer: a reading from a participant that does not share this container, was not directed by anyone in this build chain, and built nothing here, that finds the remaining coverage gaps closed. Nothing about the code at 5632495 argues against WITNESSED; what argues against it is that no such reading exists and this one is not it.

verdict: SPLIT. Landing at BUILT is supported and I found nothing that makes it wrong. BUILT -> WITNESSED is not supported for custody:phase-1-5/definition-recurrence at 5632495, and I dissent from it for reasons independent of the code.
